![Minecraft中一幕場景：一隻貓坐在床上，窗外下著雨，上方以溫暖橙色字體寫著「更柔和天氣音效」](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cdd19c0824419a3684ae022c4046cff6f0321516.jpeg)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

我從未滿意過Minecraft的天氣音效，總覺得它們要嘛刺耳、要嘛格格不入，不然就是聽起來不太享受，所以我自己做了「更柔和天氣音效」！這款資源包將Minecraft的天氣音效替換成更悅耳的聲音，全面取代了雨聲與雷電音訊！

建議搭配 Extended Weather Radius 模組使用！

如果只需要雨聲或只需要閃電與雷聲，可分別使用 更柔和雨聲 或 更好的閃電音效 資源包！

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

預覽影片使用 2.2.0 版本錄製
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- **我可以在模組包或伺服器上使用這個資源包嗎？** 可以，請盡可能拯救更多人免受原始版惱人雨聲之苦。 - **是否支援模組新增的天氣？** 我持開放態度，但前提是該天氣有令我覺得在Minecraft中惱人或突兀的預設音效。目前我不會為了替換而替換。 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

使用的音效 未註明出處的音效皆由我親自設計/錄製 所有音效皆經過編輯以達成更佳搭配效果 [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/rain-and-thunder-nature-sounds-7803/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/rain-and-thunder-nature-sounds-7803/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/soft-rain-ambient-111154/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/soft-rain-ambient-111154/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/natural-thunder-113219/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/natural-thunder-113219/) [https://freesound.org/people/bone666138/sounds/198857/](https://freesound.org/people/bone666138/sounds/198857/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/thunder-24571/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/thunder-24571/) [https://freesound.org/people/shelbyshark/sounds/513394/](https://freesound.org/people/shelbyshark/sounds/513394/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/copyright-free-rain-sounds-331497/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/copyright-free-rain-sounds-331497/) [https://freesound.org/people/Soundrack/sounds/733288/](https://freesound.org/people/Soundrack/sounds/733288/) [https://freesound.org/people/Spennnyyy/sounds/350506/](https://freesound.org/people/Spennnyyy/sounds/350506/) [https://freesound.org/people/jrosin/sounds/329978/](https://freesound.org/people/jrosin/sounds/329978/) [https://freesound.org/people/dobroide/sounds/41365/](https://freesound.org/people/dobroide/sounds/41365/) [https://freesound.org/people/fattirewhitey/sounds/523905/](https://freesound.org/people/fattirewhitey/sounds/523905/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/calm-rain-ambience-421001/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/calm-rain-ambience-421001/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/nature-winter-rain-in-oak-forest-loop-185672/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/nature-winter-rain-in-oak-forest-loop-185672/)
